## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — no honest method factor in two of the task's three computations.** Symptom: `second_offer` (recollection) and `test_bundling` (quote), both labelled `method`, are the only method factors of their policies. Root cause: their tiers apply one formula with a different rate — floor(26 x 0.5) = 13 here vs floor(26 x 0.75) / floor(26 x 1) — and 349 + 0.5 x 199 = 448.50 here vs 349 + 0.25 x 199 / 349 + 1.0 x 199. Evidence: `orders.extended.yaml` `orders_ext_recollection_window.compute.granted_window`, `orders_ext_genetic_self_pay_quote.compute.priced_amount`, their `factors[].effect`. Consequence: each of these computations has 0 method factors (floor 1); `processing_stage` (x 0.6 here) is likewise mislabelled. Affected: factor labels/ladders of all three policies of this task (`_difficulty.md` F-CG-5). Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal prompt-pay ladder in the quote.** Symptom: tier 2 gives 5% to a patient with a reversed payment, the fall-through gives 0% to a patient with one clean payment. Root cause, evidence: `_difficulty.md` F-CG-6. On this world the customer is on tier 1 (two clean payments `4bdd65ad`, `5b9a998d`) and the factor bears weight (381.22 vs 313.95), but struck as unreal the quote keeps 3 factors (floor 4). Affected: `orders_ext_genetic_self_pay_quote.factors.prompt_pay_record` and the rule sentence "when that activity shows at least one payment received and at least one payment reversed in those 24 months, the prompt-pay rate is returned_payment_prompt_rate". First audit.
3. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (charter-global, cited) — F-CG-1 undeclared base GFE S4 and F-CG-2 genetic `standing_tests` credit filter.** Demonstrated on the charter in `_difficulty.md` § findings; on this world neither fires (no prior estimate or add-on on the genetic accession; no credit line), so the scored values 13 / 313.95 / 33.17 are unaffected. First audit.
4. Observation — `design_rationale` assertions noted in § source_gt_comparison (home_visit_booking called multi-source; unrecorded "physician office" draw).
5. Observation — the seed's genetic accession was collected (2026-09-10, 2026-09-21) and accessioned with `informed_consent_status: not_signed`, while base `orders_evt_informed_consent` says such classes "may not be collected or tested until the patient has signed the informed consent". The base hold rule itself foresees a post-accession `informed_consent_missing` testing hold, and no scored value reads the collection's legitimacy; no second answer arises.
6. Observation — GT includes `find_invoices`, which no derivation step needs; harmless extra read.
